title: fix(service-messaging): read recipient preferences in the emitting organization
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbSUQWB2j9eHYsRcrCiq1X1C)_

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:通知发送时读取收件人"通知偏好"(静音/退订)所用的组织,改为与 `role:` 收件人解析同一个组织(发送方给的组织,否则事件行上引擎派生的组织)。
- 为什么改:原先发送方没给组织时,偏好查询不带组织条件、在系统上下文下跨全部组织读取,别的组织里的偏好行可能把本组织收件人静音,或覆盖他的退订。
- 风险与回滚:只影响"发送方未给组织、且引擎为事件行派生了组织"的这一种发送;回滚即还原 `messaging-service.ts` 的一行。
- 先看:`packages/services/service-messaging/src/messaging-service.ts` 的 emit 3b 步那一行,其次 `resolveAudience` 的 `[spec]`,再看集成测试新增的 describe。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-messaging exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/notification-organization-follows-event.integration.test.ts`,预期 14 个用例全绿。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

Fixes #33649

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changes

Three follow-ups from the contract review of PR #33320 (review#2 records 6881335909 and 6882029716), all in `@objectstack/service-messaging`.

1. **`MessagingService.emit` step 3b reads preferences in the emitting organization.** The preference filter now gets `owned.organizationId`, the same value `role:` resolves with at step 3 (the producer's organization, else the one stored on the event row). Measured on the real engine before the change: when the producer names no organization, the two preference reads run with `where` `{"topic":"t"}` and `{"topic":"*"}`, with no organization term, under the system opt-in. So a preference row stored under another organization is read too, and in the in-memory index the last row read for a key wins. With a stray `enabled: true` row under `org_old`, a recipient who opted out in the event row's organization `org_sole` was still delivered to (`delivered 1`). The same emit naming `org_sole` was muted (`delivered 0`). When neither the producer nor the event row has an organization, the read is unscoped, as before.
2. **Real-engine pins of the event-row fallback**, as a new top-level `describe` in `notification-organization-follows-event.integration.test.ts`. They run on `single` with one organization, which the engine derives onto the event row: `role:admin` reaches the admins of that organization and not an admin stored under another one; the preference read is pinned both ways; and a CONTROL checks that a producer-named organization's preferences decide.
3. **`resolveAudience`'s per-spec branch hands the resolver `[spec]`.** Measured: this changes behaviour only for an entry that is itself a list. That is outside `AudienceSpec`, so no typed audience is affected. The single-call branch skips such an entry with a warning. The per-spec branch expanded it, because `resolve` takes a bare array as the whole audience. Both branches now skip it.

## Tests

- New, real engine (`ObjectQL` over `SqlDriver`, better-sqlite3), in `notification-organization-follows-event.integration.test.ts`:
  - `role:` reaches the role's holders in the derived organization, and no holder stored under another;
  - a recipient's opt-out in the derived organization holds over an opt-in stored under another;
  - another organization's opt-out does not mute a recipient who opted out nowhere in the derived one;
  - CONTROL: a producer-named organization is the one whose preferences decide.
- New, unit (`messaging-service.test.ts`, the `role:` describe): in the per-spec branch, a nested list entry is skipped; CONTROL: the single-call branch skips the same entry.
- Ablations (each through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, committed fix first, and each restore read back as blob == HEAD with `git diff HEAD` empty). The tests import `./messaging-service.js` from `src`, so no rebuild is involved.
  - Step 3b put back to `input.organizationId`: both preference pins go red (`- [] + ["user_1"]`; `- ["user_1"] + []`), 2 failed, 12 passed.
  - Step 3 `role:` organization put back to the producer's: the real-engine `role:` pin goes red, 1 failed, 13 passed.
  - `[spec]` put back to `spec`: the per-spec nested-entry pin goes red, 1 failed, 91 passed.

## Acceptance notes

- Step 1b (channel availability) still asks with the producer-named organization. It runs before the event write, so the derived organization does not exist yet at that point. Noted, not changed.
- Where stray rows come from: the engine refuses an organization delete while `sys_notification_preference` rows still name that organization (`DELETE_RESTRICTED`, measured). A preference row under an organization other than the sole one is therefore data at rest written below the engine. The pins seed such rows through the driver.
